name: Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting with Backscatter Loss
definition: A volumetric rendering method that adapts 3DGS to underwater scenes by integrating ocean optics models, learning direct attenuation ($B_d$), infinite backscatter ($B_∞$), and backscatter coefficient ($B_b$), and using an alternating optimization strategy to refine depth and medium parameters.
summary: Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting with Backscatter Loss adapts 3DGS to aquatic environments by integrating ocean optics models to solve color distortion while maintaining real-time inference speeds.
